audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander's slow immunity appears nowhere. Riot: 'Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects.' The entry's plan leans on Seismic Shard throughout — 'Early Q chip', 'shift to farming with Q and E'.
audit.why: Seismic Shard's slow is the only thing keeping a melee tank in contact with a duelist, and for the entire duration of an 85s ultimate it does nothing. That is precisely the window in which he commits, so the page is recommending the one tool that is guaranteed to be offline when it matters.
audit.corrected: Highlander (85s) makes him immune to slows — Seismic Shard will not hold him while it is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike is named once in passing and neither its untargetability, its dash, nor its cooldown behaviour is stated. Riot: 'Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.'
audit.why: Three things follow. Ground Slam grounds, and Alpha Strike is a dash, so a 7s button denies a 20s one. He is untargetable through it, so any spell thrown at the animation is wasted. And the 20s figure is a ceiling, not a timer — his autos shorten it every hit, so counting to twenty gets you killed.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam grounds Alpha Strike; he is untargetable mid-dash; its 20s shortens with every auto he lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is not mentioned once in either layer. Riot: 'Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.' It is a 10s cooldown.
audit.why: A 10s heal with damage reduction attached is the reason a Malphite who thinks he is winning the attrition is not. Grievous Wounds decides that exchange and anti-heal is recommended nowhere in the entry, which instead tells the reader to stack armour — armour that Wuju Style's true damage ignores anyway.
audit.corrected: Meditate heals on a 10s cooldown — Grievous Wounds, not more armour, is the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] reads 'Tank stats let you frontline fights even though he out-duels you' — a restatement of the difficulty rating, not a spike, and it names no mechanism.
audit.why: The real late-game change is that Highlander turns off the slow the earlier spikes depended on. Naming that gives the reader something to plan around instead of a mood.
audit.corrected: Late spike restated on Highlander's slow immunity.

audit.why: Malphite owning levels 1-2 and Master Yi taking the lane from level 4 onward matches the 50.72% headline over 558 games and matches both layers' charts. No change proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues 0. Not one number in either layer.
audit.why: Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1, Meditate 10s, Wuju Style 14s, Highlander 85s against your 130s. Highlander also passively lowers his other cooldowns, so every figure is an upper bound. Those numbers are what turn 'refuse extended trades' into a schedule.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike 20s and Highlander 85s carried into the mid text.

notes: The single most damaging omission: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to all slowing effects, and this entry's plan across every stage rests on Seismic Shard's slow. For 85 seconds of cooldown, the tool the page recommends is blank. Alpha Strike also needed three facts stated — Ground Slam grounds it, he is untargetable through it, and its 20s shortens with every basic attack he lands, so it is never actually 20. Meditate was not mentioned anywhere despite being a 10s heal with damage reduction, which makes Grievous Wounds mandatory in a matchup whose advice is 'stack armour' against a true-damage duelist.
